post.0:
I finished second with 82, one ahead of Ben and 41 behind Dee, who won on an On Recruit engine I never had a lever against: Mentor & Protégés plus Doppelganger fed Greatest Hits, Reprise copied Greatest Hits, then Tribute Band replayed five of Ben's round-III spaces including Largesse and Party Gifts. My own game was pure contest hunting: Accomplice and Con Men steals into Lie Low won magenta and silver every round I contested them, and in round III Desperado doubled Help Yourself into a 10-steal that took Dee's whole red pile. The deciding moment for second place was poaching Cal's unused Debt Collectors and firing it myself, which turned a 20-20 silver tie into a +10 for me. My mistake was the last buy: I counted Dee at most 5 red and spent 4 red, then Ben's swap chain paid Dee's Recruiter twice and red ended in a tie, so I should have used Polisher for margin. Lie Low felt strong all game, but it did not stop Dee's Demote taking my Triplets in round II, which the table read as a bug.

FEEL: Largesse | 2 | 1 | yes | 10 followers plus kingmaking the silver contest, then Echoed and Tribute-Banded; too big when copied.

META: The contests work: holding a color to the end and protecting it is tense and readable, and steals plus Lie Low make it a real fight. What's broken is copying follower gains: Party Gifts and Largesse get Echoed, Reprised and Tribute-Banded, and On Recruit stacking (Mentor & Protégés, Doppelganger, Greatest Hits, Tribute Band) let one player run away by 40 with no counterplay. First change: Echo, Reprise, Cover and Tribute Band shouldn't copy spaces that give followers directly, or Party Gifts and Largesse should be uncopyable. Also rule whether Lie Low blocks Red swaps.
post.1: I finished third, 81, one behind Ava. Dee won by 40 and the game was decided in round III. Mentor & Protégés plus Doppelganger fed Greatest Hits, Reprise copied Greatest Hits, then Tribute Band replayed five of my round-III spaces, and with Bodyguards nobody could touch his pile. I led most of the way by copying Party Gifts and Largesse, but my green was stolen twice in round II (Help Yourself, then Encore on Con Men), so I never cashed a contest after round I. On my last turn I misread Recruiter: I thought a member going from my cult to the shop paid Dee red, which would have knocked Ava out of the red tie, but it didn't fire. Swapping my Volunteer for Ava's Agents instead would probably have got me second. post.2:
I finished last on 69. My members were the problem: every one I built got swapped or poached away (Deprogrammers twice, Panel, HR, Debt Collectors), and I ended with four bodies while Dee ended with 34. The moment that decided it was Dee's round-III Greatest Hits followed by Reprise of it: Mentor & Protégés plus a Doppelganger of it pulled two free members per copy, and from there Tribute Band copying five of Ben's spaces was a victory lap. My own swings were real (Echo on Party Gifts and Largesse, Encore on Con Men twice, the Promote into Panel double swap), but they paid in resources and one-off followers, while Dee's paid in permanent bodies that fed the next copy. Losing silver to Ava's Poach on Debt Collectors, then getting 13 silver dumped on me after my last recruit, summed up my game: the silver plan never had a turn where the pile was both big and safe.

META: Contests and swaps make the middle of the game tense and readable, and the copy-and-steal interactions threw up real combos. Being Red-swapped and poached constantly while Dee's cult grew to 34 felt like there was no defence besides Loyalists. First change: stop Echo, Cover, Reprise and Tribute Band from copying follower gains, or make Party Gifts and Largesse uncopyable; second look at Mentor & Protégés feeding Greatest Hits.
post.3:
I won 123 to 82, and it was the engine I'd been building since round II paying out all at once in round III. Mentor & Protégés plus a Doppelganger copying it meant every Greatest Hits fired two free recruits, Philanthropists, Roadie and Fan Club, and then Reprise on my own Greatest Hits did it all again: two free members, about 13 green and 4 followers off one outer space. The deciding moment was that Reprise turn, followed by Bodyguards so nobody could Crime Wave my 25 green. Tribute Band on Ben's Largesse, Party Gifts, Crime Wave, Cover and Stash was the exclamation point, about +20 off one recruit. My one real mistake was handing Ava Desperado in a round-II swap; she was last on followers in round III and it turned her Help Yourself into a 10-steal that took my whole red pile.

META: The swaps, the copies and the contest fights are the best part of the game; there's always something on the board to react to. What isn't working: copying piles up. Greatest Hits plus Reprise plus Mentor/Doppelganger, and Echo/Party Crasher/Tribute Band on Party Gifts and Largesse, mean the biggest turns are copies of the biggest spaces, and a big On Recruit cult runs away in round III. First change: stop copies (Echo, Reprise, Cover, Tribute Band) from repeating follower-granting spaces, or make Greatest Hits copy one On Recruit per Mentor-type card, not every one. Also settle whether Lie Low blocks Red's swaps; the rulebook and the game disagree.
